results.content:
Key Points

 Hyundai is the largest U.S. importer of new vehicles from South Korea, followed by GM.
 Both automakers have paid billions of dollars in tariffs so far this year after President Donald Trump placed 25% tariffs on vehicles imported from South Korea other countries in the spring.
 Now, the Trump administration said the tariff rate for vehicles from South Korea will drop to 15% as part of a trade deal. [...] American flags flutter outside a Hyundai automobile dealership in Irvine, California, U.S., March 27, 2025.

Mike Blake | Reuters

DETROIT — Hyundai Motor and General Motors are set to be two of the greatest beneficiaries of lower U.S. tariffs on imports, including vehicles, from South Korea. [...] Hyundai aims to have more than 80% of its U.S. vehicle sales be produced locally by 2030, the company said this year. That compares with roughly 40% currently.

Despite the tariffs, GM is estimated to import nearly 422,000 vehicles from South Korea this year to the U.S., according to GlobalData. That would be a 3.6% increase compared with record imports of more than 407,000 units last year.

results.title: Your Hyundais And Kias Won't Explode In Price Thanks To Last-Minute Tariff Deal
results.content: South Korea and the United States brokered a last-minute tariffs deal on Wednesday, meaning the price of cars from your favorite Korean brands like Hyundai and Kia won't explode higher, though there will likely still be some increases. Much like the deal signed with Europe and another with Japan earlier in July, the latest agreement lowers the auto tariff on cars and parts built in South Korea to 15%, down from the 25% that would be in effect after the August 1 “Liberation Day” deadline – when [...] In addition to the duty-free access for US exports to South Korea, the deal is also a boon for American automakers that import products from South Korea, like General Motors, whose Chevrolet Trax and Buick Envista are built in the country. Polestar is also geared to start building its Polestar 4 in South Korea later this year for export to the US. The Polestar 4 was originally due to be imported from China, but Polestar made arrangements to build the electric compact crossover in South Korea [...] South Korea is also a major exporter of critical car parts used by manufacturers in the US, especially in the areas of computer chips, digital equipment, batteries for electric vehicles, and steel.
